core.title: Round Lined Cabinet Pull, Acorn KP8JP

text.description_html:
Acorn KP8JP, Round 3 Lined Cabinet Pull

A subtle way to add beauty to your home, Acorn's Round Lined Cabinet Pull is hand forged out of stainless steel using the traditional techniques of the anvil and hammer. This pull features a three line design that keeps this simple pull from being too plain. The forging process darkens the stainless steel in an uneven pattern, providing a natural finish (similar to antique nickel or pewter). It is this natural stainless steel finish that is perfect for not only modern decors but also more traditional styles, able to accent this contemporary material with a natural feel that just seems to belong in any setting.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality hand forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Round Lined Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length: 3-3/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
